title: TaDiCodec: Text-aware Diffusion Speech Tokenizer for Speech Language Modeling
one_line: Text-aware diffusion tokenizer for ultra-low bitrate speech compression.
innovations: Text-aware diffusion decoder for extreme compression
Binary spherical quantization without explicit codebook
Prompt mechanism for improved reconstruction quality
method_framework: TaDiCodec uses a diffusion autoencoder with text-aware decoding and binary spherical quantization to achieve ultra-low bitrate (0.0875 kbps) while maintaining high speech quality.
experiment_framework: Evaluated on SeedTTS test sets with WER, SIM, UTMOS metrics; compared with multiple baselines including EnCodec, DAC, CosyVoice, and Mimi.
takeaways: Text guidance significantly improves reconstruction quality at ultra-low bitrates
Binary spherical quantization eliminates need for commitment loss
End-to-end training simplifies pipeline while maintaining performance
weaknesses: Decoder continued-training required for optimal performance
Inference steps still relatively high for real-time applications
